title: GeoCool-In
summary: A monitoring platform for geothermal climate systems on farms. Sensors on site collect the data and the web shows what is going on. Still in progress.
role: I lead the technical side: the architecture, the monorepo and the first version of the web in Next.js and Payload CMS. Next comes the sensor pipeline, from Raspberry Pi to a time-series database.

title: Shyla Jewellery
summary: Online shop for a jewellery brand, built headless: Shopify runs the commerce, Sanity the content and Next.js the storefront.
role: Part of a small team. I worked on the storefront and the shop features, brought in Shopify data through GraphQL and built interactions and animations with GSAP.

title: Startup Radar
summary: A platform for entrepreneurship programmes, built for Madrid+d: startups, mentors, incubators and institutions in one place, with more than 6,000 users.
role: I took over an existing Django codebase and kept it growing as the programmes changed: user roles, admin workflows and all the data behind companies, mentors, meetings and documents.

title: VIT
summary: Website and back office for Viatges Independents i Trekkings, a travel agency.
role: Built end to end on my own with Django: a custom trip search, tools for the agency staff and a back office that turns database content into styled PDF travel documents and Excel files. I also handled the deployment.

title: Prewaste
summary: Corporate website for an engineering company, told as a story that unfolds as you scroll.
role: Built on my own on WordPress with a custom front end. Most of the work went into the scroll-driven animations: GSAP, ScrollMagic, Lottie and custom SVG.

title: Live Unfinished
summary: An event website with Bizzabo's event tools built in and restyled to feel like part of the site.
role: Built front and back on my own with Django, wrote the JavaScript and SVG animations, and deployed it with nginx and Gunicorn.

title: Barabási Lab
summary: Portfolio site for an artist and scientist, with a large body of work you explore through search.
role: Built front and back on my own with Django. The centrepiece is a live search across every type of content, with animated results that load as you browse.

heading: Hi, I'm Elsa.
bio:
Full-stack software engineer based in Barcelona. I build web applications end to end, with a focus on complex front ends.

I have an industrial engineering background with experience in scientific computing. I love coding, modelling and planning.

I also make music and I'm passionate about cinema, culture, people and cooking.

title: Dinàmica
summary: Website for Dinàmica Arquitectura, an architecture studio.
role: All mine, front and back: built with Django and Webpack, with GSAP animations that follow the scroll.

title: No és culpa meva
summary: Website for a public mental health campaign, where people could read, watch and share their own stories. The site is no longer online.
role: Full stack, about 80% of the build. Django and PostgreSQL behind; in front, horizontal layouts, window-like interactions and animations with GSAP, AOS and Swiper.
